ui.team.page_subtitle: Super admins and group leaders can assign tasks; members work through their assignments
ui.team.empty_can_create_desc: Click “New to-do” in the top right to assign the first task
ui.team.empty_filtered_desc: No to-dos match the current filters
ui.team.guest_title: Sign in to view team to-dos
ui.team.guest_desc: Team to-dos are available to super admins, group leaders, and assigned members
ui.team.disabled_desc: An administrator turned off team to-dos in Settings → Permissions; turn it back on to use this page again
ui.team.leader_panel_desc: As a group leader, manage this group's members and visibility here
ui.team.remove_member_desc: After removal they will no longer see content visible to this group; if they are a leader of this group, the leader role is removed as well.
ui.team.dialog_leader_desc: You are a leader of this group, so you can adjust its members and visibility.
ui.team.dialog_viewer_desc: You have view-only access; changes require a super admin or a group leader with the right permissions.
ui.team.no_view_members: “View this group's member list” is not enabled in the leader permissions
ui.team.remove_hint: Removing a member also cancels their group leader role.
ui.team.whitelist_placeholder:
One directory per line, relative to the drive root:
ProjectA
Public
ui.team.whitelist_hint: Leave empty for no restriction; if set, group members can only see these directories and their subdirectories.
ui.team.blacklist_placeholder:
One directory per line:
Confidential
Financials
ui.team.blacklist_hint: Takes priority over the allowlist; hidden directories simply appear as “non-existent” to group members.
ui.team.editor_new_desc: Choose the scope and priority; the assignees will see this task.
ui.team.editor_edit_desc: Title, note, priority, and due date can all be changed; only the creator or a manager can change the scope.
ui.team.title_hint: Describe the task in one sentence; it appears on the first line of the list.
ui.team.priority_hint: A badge in the list marks it high or low
ui.team.due_hint: Overdue items are shown in red
ui.team.scope_hint: Determines who can see this to-do
ui.team.group_scope_hint: Every member of this group will see this to-do.
ui.team.member_scope_hint: Only the assigned member (and you) can see this to-do.
ui.team.allow_assignee_edit: Allow assigned members to edit the content
ui.team.allow_assignee_edit_on_hint: When enabled, assignees can also change the title and note.
ui.team.allow_assignee_edit_off_hint: Only the creator or a manager can change this.
